title: The Teacups on a Wobbly Tray
youtube_title: The Teacups on a Wobbly Tray | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Helping without being asked is a quiet sort of brave.
summary: At a harbor step where parcels change hands, a teacups chiming on a wobbly tray is awkward for one person. Una notices Papa struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
